user.title: Connect Pulsar DALI
user.description: Choose whether this Home Assistant connects to its local add-on or to a remote Pulsar DALI server.

local.title: Local Pulsar DALI add-on
local.description: Use the internal Home Assistant app network. No token or TLS fingerprint is required.

data.scan_on_setup: Scan all three DALI buses during setup

remote.title: Remote Pulsar DALI server
remote.description: Use HTTPS with bearer-token authentication and SHA-256 certificate pinning. Copy the token and fingerprint from the Remote page on the Pulsar DALI add-on.

data.scan_on_setup: Scan all three DALI buses during setup

error.invalid_token: The API token is too short

abort.already_configured: This Pulsar DALI controller is already configured

scan.title: Scan DALI buses
scan.description: Non-destructive scan of both control gear and DALI-2 control devices. Reads groups, scenes, parameters, button/PIR/light-sensor instances and event configuration.

detect_conflicts.title: Detect duplicate short addresses
detect_conflicts.description: Reads the 24-bit random address of occupied short addresses. Backward-frame collisions are marked as conflicts. No configuration is changed.

change_address.title: Select gear to move
change_address.description: Only gear without a detected address conflict is shown.

change_address_edit.title: Change short address — {gear}
change_address_edit.description: The target is checked as free, an automatic backup is made and the address and random identity are verified after writing.

data.confirm: I want to change the address

repair_conflict.title: Repair duplicate short address
repair_conflict.description: This changes addresses and creates an automatic backup. If the previous random address is known, that gear is restored to the original short address and other responders are commissioned to free addresses.

data.confirm: I want to repair the conflict

commission_unaddressed.title: Commission unaddressed control gear
commission_unaddressed.description: Uses INITIALISE → RANDOMISE → SEARCHADDR → COMPARE → PROGRAM SHORT ADDRESS → VERIFY → WITHDRAW while preserving existing addresses. An automatic backup is created.

data.confirm: I want to commission unaddressed gear

clear_address.title: Clear short address
clear_address.description: Makes the selected unique gear unaddressed. Use conflict repair when several gears share the address. An automatic backup is created.

data.confirm: I want to clear the short address

backup.title: Create DALI configuration backup
backup.description: Stores the current scanned data as JSON in the add-on persistent /data/backups folder.

scenes.title: Edit DALI scenes
scenes.description: Select control gear, scene and level. Scene levels are stored individually in each gear. Select Remove to store MASK/not a member.

inputs.title: DALI-2 input devices
inputs.description:
{input_summary}

The recommended event profile sets event scheme 2 (device/instance) and enables the instance. Push-buttons also get the original Pulsar event filter 0x54. Scanning itself changes nothing.

connection.title: Connection
connection.description: Update the API connection. For remote mode use the HTTPS URL plus token and SHA-256 fingerprint. Leave token/fingerprint empty for local mode.

error.confirmation_required: You must confirm before this action can run
